description: Update one of your client aliases. Only the fields you send change. ⚠️ `slots` REPLACES THE WHOLE ORDERED SET — it is not a merge and not an append, so read the alias with gate_client_alias_get first and send back the full list you want. Use enabled=false to take an alias out of service while keeping it (the reversible alternative to deleting it). Requires the admin role.

enabled.description: Arm (true) or take out of service (false).

name.description: The short leaf of the alias to update.

slots.description: REPLACES the whole ordered chain, 1–16 entries. Omit to leave slots untouched.

enabled.description: Default true. A disabled slot is skipped.

integration_id.description: YOUR OWN provider key (api_integrations.id) that funds this slot.

name: gate_client_alias_update
